basis: Inferred from the returned scores: every public score is a whole number of correct patches out of 95 and every private score out of 205, and 95 + 205 = 300 holdout samples, the only pair of sizes that fits all ten scores of the study. This confirms accuracy as the leaderboard metric.
note: The study submitted ten files; this repository holds the seven that the paper reports (S01 to S05, S07, S09). n_submissions counts all ten.
